method.derivative: adjacent full-precision raw IMU poses / positive full sensor tick delta
method.feedback: body-frame pose derivative minus midpoint model VELOCITY; includes all measurement updates and output timing effects
method.means: pair velocities are sensor-dt weighted; IMU residual means use matched output samples
method.onset: recorded stationary duration crosses from <=100 ms to >100 ms
limitations: No independent physical ground truth; actual hand acceleration contributes.
Residual acceleration also contains attitude/gravity, scale and optical-model errors.
Output-minus-model velocity is not an isolated optical innovation or proof of its cause.
Stationary-onset association is observational, not a replay that isolates the update.
Equivalent constant bias assumes recorded attitude and zero physical acceleration; not a calibration to apply.
